gameModes.ruleSummary: Complete any full horizontal row, vertical column, or main diagonal (center cell is FREE).
Mark all four outer corner cells (row 0/col 0, row 0/col 4, row 4/col 0, row 4/col 4).
Mark both main diagonals forming an X across all 9 diagonal cells.
Mark every number on the 5x5 card (all 24 numbered cells plus FREE center).
